cohort: 81 pregnant women with singleton pregnancy who underwent cesarean section due to posterior placenta previa
finding: Quantifying cervical varicosities using MRI, specifically the A/B ratio (minimum distance from the most dorsal cervical varicosity to the deciduous placenta divided by the minimum distance to the amniotic placenta), was effective in prenatally predicting placenta accreta in women with posterior placenta previa.
